styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless misty blue-grey #C9D3E0 studio backdrop for hero/variant/interior screens, pure white #FFFFFF for infographic sections, carbon charcoal #26282E dark chapter band for lock and wheel-structure screens

styleLock.surfaceSystem: seamless matte studio backdrop, no visible tabletop texture; pavement and building entrance only in the street scene
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with short bold headlines and short labels, no dense body text

styleLock.presentationRules: stable front and slight 3/4 hero angles for the case, consistent scale across the set, wheels always grounded with a soft contact shadow
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent clean travel-gear ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of mist white #FFFFFF, misty blue-grey #C9D3E0, carbon charcoal #26282E and one slate-blue accent #5B7CA6; neutral-cool lighting with soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif short bold headlines and short labels; consistent rounded info chips and thin-line icons; matte hard-shell luggage rendering with stable product scale and placement; clean margins around the product; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 从 13 张详情页长图切片提炼（旅行拉杆箱2）。已剥离：源品牌名与店铺信息、TSA002 刻印与红色徽标、旅行箱1A 型号引用、热销52万件销量话术、会员二维码。源图规格面板与正文矛盾（面板写全铝镁合金/18寸，正文与实拍为 PC 材质/20寸），尺码一律不继承任何数字，规格行以 {product} 占位、由投放时填入真实参数。归类以实拍图为准（磨砂PC蜂窝纹硬壳三色拉杆箱）。
